patthana8.14:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ca na no āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana8.14:2.1: na no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, (saṃkhittaṃ.)
patthana8.14:3.1: no āsavañca na no āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. no āsavañca na no āsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca no āsavo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.14:4.1: hetuyā nava, ārammaṇe nava, avigate nava, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ) na sāsavaṃ
